scenes.title: Anomaly Detected
scenes.speaker: Sarah
scenes.dialogue: Look at these telemetry logs. Our atmospheric scrubbers are fluctuating beyond normal tolerance thresholds.
scenes.imagePrompt: Modern high-tech research facility control room, cinematic lighting, a female scientist examining glowing holographic data charts showing declining performance, 16:9 widescreen presentation slide style

scenes.title: Evaluating Operational Risk
scenes.speaker: Marcus
scenes.dialogue: If we don't address this within 48 hours, the downstream manufacturing pipeline halts. We need an immediate action plan.
